question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
WITH annual_sales AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) AS businessentityid,
           TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(orderdate AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS order_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales
    FROM salesorderheader 
    WHERE TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY salespersonid, order_year
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT BusinessEntityID,
           TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(QuotaDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS quota_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS annual_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, quota_year
)
SELECT a.businessentityid AS salesperson_id,
       a.order_year AS year,
       a.total_sales,
       q.annual_quota,
       a.total_sales - q.annual_quota AS difference
FROM annual_sales a
JOIN annual_quota q ON a.businessentityid = q.BusinessEntityID AND a.order_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY a.businessentityid, a.order_year
